newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 20.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Death of France's "Mr Africa" Jacques Foccart, who kept African leaders in perpetual fear of coups, marks end of era, one of French interventionism in the continent, editorial says.

- Government sets up committee for permanent dialogue and conciliation in universities following student unrest this year over allowances and conditions; committee includes student leader Guillaume Soro, detained briefly during the unrest
- Students arrested in eastern town of Bongouanou on second day of 72-hour pay strike by secondary school teachers; teachers questioned by police elsewhere, school distrupted
- Representatives of Ivory Coast's financial sector call for privately run industrial development bank to help boost investment
- Chartered accountants in Ivory Coast examine implications of the European Community's planned switch to the Euro for the CFA franc
- West African states meeting to discuss regional security call for creation of institute to study crime in the region and a data base to help crack down on criminals

- School in western town of Daloa part ransacked and closed after clashes between police and students; students turned on police after they stopped them lynching a Nigerian accused of being a sorcerer who made penises shrink or vanish.
